verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs say it publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Billing API, maintained at github.com/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi (v1/openapi.yaml). It is meant for client generation and import into tools like Scalar, Redocly and Stoplight, and an importable Postman collection covering every operation is also offered. The probe's 404s only hit guessed well-known paths on developer.paddle.com, not the documented GitHub location, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec file downloads and is complete; no spec is served at a conventional discoverable URL on the docs domain.
